samples: This program implements a role-based access control system that checks whether a combination of user roles grants all permissions required for an action. It provides functions to compute the union of permissions across roles, identify missing permissions, verify authorization, and find shared permissions between roles. The sample main function demonstrates checking whether a viewer and editor together can publish posts, and reports any missing permissions.
